mapper.sql: r.id, r.code, r.name, r.description, r.status, r.data_scope, r.is_system, r.created_by, r.created_at, r.updated_by, r.updated_at, r.version, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ur.user_id) FROM user_role ur JOIN app_user u ON u.id = ur.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE ur.role_id = r.id) AS user_count

UPDATE role SET deleted = 1, updated_by = #{by}, updated_at = NOW(3), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND deleted = 0
